episodes.synopsis: Momo believes in ghosts. Okarun believes in aliens. To make each other believe what they deny, they head to a spot famous for UFO sightings and a spiritual hotspot.
episodes.title: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know!

episodes.synopsis: Momo awakens psychic powers, while Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny. They evacuate to Momo's house, but a giant alien appears before them.
episodes.title: That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!

episodes.synopsis: After Momo's grandmother temporarily suppresses the evil spirit within Okarun, she says that a game of tag may be the key to defeating it for good.
episodes.title: It's a Granny vs. Granny Clash!

episodes.synopsis: Okarun and Momo arrive at the tunnel to confront Turbo Granny. Just when they think they've won, a giant crab spirit crashes through the wall.
episodes.title: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass

episodes.synopsis: Momo and Okarun’s ordeal with Turbo Granny has brought them closer, but things remain awkward between them. Okarun realizes he still has a problem.
episodes.title: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!

episodes.synopsis: Turbo Granny reveals that Okarun's missing organs are contained within golden spheres. Aira, who has found one, now has the ability to see spirits.
episodes.title: A Dangerous Woman Arrives

episodes.synopsis: Momo and Okarun manage to weaken Acrobatic Silky but make a shocking discovery regarding Aira. Acrobatic Silky suggests a surprising way to help.
episodes.title: To a Kinder World

episodes.synopsis: Aira begins to develop a crush on Okarun. As the three friends' emotions intertwine, they suddenly face another extraterrestrial emergency.
episodes.title: I've Got This Funny Feeling

episodes.synopsis: Aira has awakened the powers of Acrobatic Silky within her and fights the Serpoians alongside Okarun and Momo.
episodes.title: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!

episodes.synopsis: Okarun and the girls try to clean up some misunderstandings with their classmates. The aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.
episodes.title: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?

episodes.synopsis: Momo's childhood friend Jiji has come to stay with the Ayases. He explains that he needs Seiko’s help with some strange phenomena at his house.
episodes.title: First Love

episodes.synopsis: On the way to investigate the Enjoji house, Okarun feels uneasy about Jiji's closeness to Momo but finds himself drawn to his friendly nature.
episodes.title: Let's Go to the Cursed House
